units.source_text: 先说说今年春天，有个来自日本的年轻旅行家要去上海看赛马，领略中国南方的大好河山。

en.t: First, in the spring of this year, a young traveler from Japan was going to Shanghai to watch the horse races and take in the beautiful mountains and rivers of southern China.

units.source_text: 在好奇心的驱使下，这个人在金花房中度过了一个夜晚。

en.t: Driven by curiosity, this man spent a night in Jinhua's room.

units.source_text: 那个时候，他嘴里叼着香烟，把娇小的金花抱在穿着洋装的膝盖上，

en.t: At that moment, with a cigarette in his mouth, he was holding the petite Jinhua on his Western-dressed lap,

units.source_text: 却突然看到了墙上的十字架，不由自主的露出了不解的表情。

en.t: but suddenly he saw the cross on the wall and, without meaning to, showed a puzzled expression.
